name: Tailed Adept
body:
Unlike other wyrmtouched, your tail is incredibly dangerous.

Prerequisite(s): Powerful tail racial trait, character level 5th.

Benefit(s): Your tail attack is treated as a primary attack.

Special: If you possess the brutal dragoon racial trait, the damage die increase also applies to your tail.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
